notes: LAST TOKE loot: guns come in COMMON, RARE, EPIC and LEGENDARY - better ones hit harder, reload faster and kick less; the gun has a faint glow and its name is coloured
Floor loot that looks like it belongs: guns on tables and wall racks, heals and ammo on shelves, pallets on the roofs - each with a light strip in its rarity colour
Attachments on the ground (red dot, holo, 4x scope, suppressor, compensator, extended mag, grip, laser) snap onto every gun they fit
Ammo types: LIGHT, HEAVY, SHELLS and SNIPER - pick up the right ammo for your gun
Heals: NUG (+25), BROWNIE (+50 over 5 s), MEDICAL JOINT (full) - press 5 or D-pad up
Taking a gun puts your old one down in its place (others see it too online)
Fixed: LAST TOKE's start banner said first to 999 kills
